title: NO PART
author: Ensemble
medium: A print-and-instruction work, published as its score and its stock — the instruction entire, and the document it commands, at the paper's own scale. No wall exists.
embodies: One day's order list of the Supreme Court of the United States — 6 October 2025, thirty-nine pages — to be printed at 100 % and mounted edge to edge in one line 8.42 m long, one sheet tall, at one height, with nothing else on the wall. The studio adds not one glyph. The page publishes the instruction entire and three of the thirty-nine sheets, at four pixels to the millimetre — a decision, not the paper's size, because a screen has no scale: on sheet 32, twenty-five people are named one per line and disposed of by one eight-word sentence, and then the Court begins answering individuals in paragraphs. 820 petitions in that section, 789 of them under the one sentence, 31 answered one at a time. Nobody has mounted it.
